editorial_thesis: 妥当性は、詳細さ・測定量・記憶量・介入量の一方向の序列ではなく、各科学的責任に対する再利用可能性と禁止推論の境界として評価される。
claim_ceiling: The final chapter order does not transfer theorem, code, data, or evidence ownership to theouni.
The worldline atlas remains a non-ordered theory map; this file fixes only the dissertation traversal.
MRM and RACH remain independent companion programmes but are not primary dissertation chapters in this final ten-chapter spine.
TU-2, TU-3, and TU-4 remain embedded firewalls; TU-1 is the synthesis module.
Chapter 2 may precede Chapter 4 editorially because warning outcomes import their source-frozen loss/event definitions rather than deriving them from the later chapter.

units.title: 再利用問題
units.headline_result: The dissertation asks when a representation that was adequate for one scientific responsibility may be reused after the responsibility changes.
units.forbidden_inference: 一度うまくいった表現 ⇒ 以後どの責任にも再利用できる表現

units.title: 観測が原理的に届かない範囲
units.english_title: Where Observation Cannot Reach in Principle
units.headline_result: Mechanistic proximity and identification strength are distinct: endpoint-only observation leaves k-1 product-preserving degrees of freedom, and r independent channel anchors leave k-1-r.
units.forbidden_inference: 観測を豊かにした ⇒ 潜在機構に近づいた

units.title: 先行することは、警告することではない
units.headline_result: Frozen genetic erosion thresholds can precede every audited event yet fire in every audited non-event, so temporal precedence alone does not establish predictive warning validity.
units.forbidden_inference: 損失に先行した ⇒ 損失を予告する

units.title: 境界の内側で、次に何を測るか
units.english_title: What to Measure Next Inside the Boundary
units.headline_result: Among verified candidate observations, information-guided sequential design ranks measurements by current mechanism information and recomputes value after each realised outcome rather than treating every measurable variable as equally useful.
units.forbidden_inference: 測れるものは測る価値がある ⇒ 測る順序に良し悪しはない

units.title: 一つの系に、状態は一つではない
units.english_title: One System Does Not Have One State
units.headline_result: Potential viability, realised occupancy, demographic state, genetic diversity, and allele persistence can respond differently to the same fragmentation contrast, while coarse marginals can hide transition-relevant cross-layer alignment.
units.forbidden_inference: 生態遺伝的に要約した ⇒ 五つの側面を代表した

units.title: 未来を開くと、記憶が要る
units.headline_result: Interfaces that remain small under fixed closed future grammars can require exponentially more states, or m additional bits, when the legal future grammar is opened.
units.forbidden_inference: 物理的境界が狭い ⇒ 必要な因果記憶も小さい

units.title: 能力は知識を追い越す
units.headline_result: For every m >= 1, one newly admitted controllable action can add exactly one viable world while forcing a retained present slice to refine from one state to 2^m states, producing exactly m bits of monitoring debt under unchanged evidence.
units.forbidden_inference: 介入の規模が小さい ⇒ 表現と監視の負担も小さい

units.title: 法則は構造置換を越えない
units.english_title: Laws Do Not Automatically Survive Structural Replacement
units.headline_result: An inherited source macro-law transports only under explicit source-target coherence; otherwise the target requires source-relative repair and, when routes disagree, explicit history context.
units.forbidden_inference: ある構造で成り立った法則 ⇒ 置換後の構造でも成り立つ法則

units.title: 反復は、多様性の代わりにならない
units.english_title: Repetition Does Not Substitute for Diversity
units.headline_result: Repeated observations sharing one failure domain cannot generally substitute for independent failure opportunities; target reporting remains set-valued unless the declared observation and risk contract supports sharper resolution.
units.forbidden_inference: 同じ手法を繰り返した ⇒ 証拠が強くなった

units.title: 総合 — 妥当性に特権的な方向はない
units.english_title: Synthesis — Adequacy Has No Privileged Direction
units.headline_result: TU-1 shows that revisability after compression is a factorization property, while the dissertation as a whole shows that richer observation, larger state, longer memory, stronger intervention, and repeated evidence are not one monotone axis of scientific adequacy.
units.forbidden_inference: より詳細にする／より多く測る／より長く記憶する／より多く介入する ⇒ より妥当になる

source_preconditions.condition: Warning event/non-event labels and loss endpoints are imported from the frozen EGWE/parent source contracts; Chapter 2 does not infer them from Chapter 4.

MRM.role: mechanism-response companion; may support Chapters 3-4 but owns no primary chapter here

RACH.role: causal-programme companion and historical substrate for MROD; comparison material for Chapter 3
